p.bio: Edouard Masse is the bowman on board Team France. At the front of the boat Edouard akka Doudou is in charge of the spinnaker and the mast. He is also helping the helmsman and tactician to gauge the line and distance to other boats during the start or other manoeuvres. A rôle he is mastering to near perfection after 5 Tour de France and many seasons in IRC and TP 52.

s: Audi 52 SUPER SERIES Porto Cervo Sailing Week
